Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 34, "heading": "CHAPTER 32. THE BEGINNING OF A LONG JOURNEY", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u034-b0126", "target": "— Мисс Дартл, — ответил я, — вы наверняка не настолько несправедливы, чтобы осуждать МЕНЯ!", "source_sha256": "31f763c4a4f465f3e8e33e97a8b9b149322c6d586a12b180d3cb766fd14a0f4b", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0126", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "13505b900bad9e4fd38f3518707033aaa05bcba8ddeb06efbaea8a0cf8491d9a"}, {"source_id": "en85-u034-b0127", "target": "— Зачем вы вносите раздор между этими двумя безумцами? — возразила она. — Разве вы не знаете, что оба они безумны от собственного упрямства и гордыни?", "source_sha256": "7bde80b2cd37b4ddc99f854213eaa5880b31ff6b65ccc10a7bd9bc521a4907ab", "target_id": "ru-en85-u034-b0127", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6ae38d3e7a45da8722008778c0cf07ea7392393ca03d89b8b85ea13de03042a2"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 32, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u034-b0128", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is it my doing?’ I returned.", "sha256": "cb2c6a7169dfc7c92ebc4a17cad60a70f66631f1c5ee0504145c296ce2759973", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[128]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0129", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is it your doing!’ she retorted. ‘Why do you bring this man here?’", "sha256": "95ad32fe37b8e04ec8b39276c1cebbf6075723969eac765f506ab150524829b8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[129]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0130", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He is a deeply-injured man, Miss Dartle,’ I replied. ‘You may not know it.’", "sha256": "a3fdb7abeb367528d9bc9763be986ab1bd5d81d0f7d7cd1758106e4dc44c9329", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[130]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0131", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know that James Steerforth,’ she said, with her hand on her bosom, as if to prevent the storm that was raging there, from being loud, ‘has a false, corrupt heart, and is a traitor. But what need I know or care about this fellow, and his common niece?’", "sha256": "3c818c5d26cbc1d4b971cf0f1bad5cfd20aae201e521f56d96a1ade869fdc923", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[131]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0132", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Miss Dartle,’ I returned, ‘you deepen the injury. It is sufficient already. I will only say, at parting, that you do him a great wrong.’", "sha256": "ac90f5d85575e01d73ed75757b26818f00cd8408f343e7ec42f139c3d703a2c2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[132]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0133", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I do him no wrong,’ she returned. ‘They are a depraved, worthless set. I would have her whipped!’", "sha256": "20cf1c988118bd978529e6e26b8dc913c52c64e336dade37dae1bfa86e6da4db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[133]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0134", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Peggotty passed on, without a word, and went out at the door.", "sha256": "b72f8f0e5abf03c29c5b2817a3f7544c276e571b951c56bf6c5011e013a7e7d5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[134]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0135", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, shame, Miss Dartle! shame!’ I said indignantly. ‘How can you bear to trample on his undeserved affliction!’", "sha256": "f67c1b6bb4d5208336145fb2ecc978e5ac9a00e764221d666618d79f52d61ab6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[135]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0136", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I would trample on them all,’ she answered. ‘I would have his house pulled down. I would have her branded on the face, dressed in rags, and cast out in the streets to starve. If I had the power to sit in judgement on her, I would see it done. See it done? I would do it! I detest her. If I ever could reproach her with her infamous condition, I would go anywhere to do so. If I could hunt her to her grave, I would. If there was any word of comfort that would be a solace to her in her dying hour, and only I possessed it, I wouldn’t part with it for Life itself.’", "sha256": "e014e58909a2d9171af006d29e9f479e3866e67d557b649fe74a6abe8eb74d8d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[136]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0137", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The mere vehemence of her words can convey, I am sensible, but a weak impression of the passion by which she was possessed, and which made itself articulate in her whole figure, though her voice, instead of being raised, was lower than usual. No description I could give of her would do justice to my recollection of her, or to her entire deliverance of herself to her anger. I have seen passion in many forms, but I have never seen it in such a form as that.", "sha256": "3d6165d9f45cfac76f81c6970e7abe0b222ccad7e040b8e80707a65f40ce3aaa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[137]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0138", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "When I joined Mr. Peggotty, he was walking slowly and thoughtfully down the hill. He told me, as soon as I came up with him, that having now discharged his mind of what he had purposed doing in London, he meant ‘to set out on his travels’, that night. I asked him where he meant to go? He only answered, ‘I’m a going, sir, to seek my niece.’", "sha256": "0bf3acd0ffe30f2605b1132c6de5eac779ce693cdc85b589486ce20ef440e8ac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[138]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0139", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We went back to the little lodging over the chandler’s shop, and there I found an opportunity of repeating to Peggotty what he had said to me. She informed me, in return, that he had said the same to her that morning. She knew no more than I did, where he was going, but she thought he had some project shaped out in his mind.", "sha256": "90b2d6fe0935159679d2300556047e1203f90f014925b43df9ac757176f41fa5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[139]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0140", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I did not like to leave him, under such circumstances, and we all three dined together off a beefsteak pie—which was one of the many good things for which Peggotty was famous—and which was curiously flavoured on this occasion, I recollect well, by a miscellaneous taste of tea, coffee, butter, bacon, cheese, new loaves, firewood, candles, and walnut ketchup, continually ascending from the shop. After dinner we sat for an hour or so near the window, without talking much; and then Mr. Peggotty got up, and brought his oilskin bag and his stout stick, and laid them on the table.", "sha256": "f062fa6a6452512ac29bff0520ccfceb86bc581a85c6ce1a875106d3f0796afc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[140]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0141", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He accepted, from his sister’s stock of ready money, a small sum on account of his legacy; barely enough, I should have thought, to keep him for a month. He promised to communicate with me, when anything befell him; and he slung his bag about him, took his hat and stick, and bade us both ‘Good-bye!’", "sha256": "387637ceeb21924fc5b2251c99d4f0845e911f5797ad979c475e575dfae8aacf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[141]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0142", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘All good attend you, dear old woman,’ he said, embracing Peggotty, ‘and you too, Mas’r Davy!’ shaking hands with me. ‘I’m a-going to seek her, fur and wide. If she should come home while I’m away—but ah, that ain’t like to be!—or if I should bring her back, my meaning is, that she and me shall live and die where no one can’t reproach her. If any hurt should come to me, remember that the last words I left for her was, “My unchanged love is with my darling child, and I forgive her!”’", "sha256": "09ff9c59a17919234455bbeb373688534590f8c9d4b7aceaeedfb9fe1352a691", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[142]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0143", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He said this solemnly, bare-headed; then, putting on his hat, he went down the stairs, and away. We followed to the door. It was a warm, dusty evening, just the time when, in the great main thoroughfare out of which that by-way turned, there was a temporary lull in the eternal tread of feet upon the pavement, and a strong red sunshine. He turned, alone, at the corner of our shady street, into a glow of light, in which we lost him.", "sha256": "6662613514403a34a681c64a105b4ec521522374b57ba2098e6a1b31e58ce545", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[143]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0144", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Rarely did that hour of the evening come, rarely did I wake at night, rarely did I look up at the moon, or stars, or watch the falling rain, or hear the wind, but I thought of his solitary figure toiling on, poor pilgrim, and recalled the words:", "sha256": "4113f8a0c52e451c5542364a9e68e254ba9191b7e29771e038ba05a14e09916c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[144]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u034-b0145", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I’m a going to seek her, fur and wide. If any hurt should come to me, remember that the last words I left for her was, “My unchanged love is with my darling child, and I forgive her!”’", "sha256": "4e094ab6f9dbc1a49786a3d6fdeaf3eb8bfc44b2d54a517f7ca525312826bc6f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[39]/p[145]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
